verdict.rationale: Justworks documents creating PTO policies under Time Off > Policies > + Add policy in the Payroll account. Setup fields include policy name, start and end dates, type, policy cycle, balance structure and timecard sync, and holidays are set automatically. Accrual configuration is only implied by 'balance structure' and 'policy cycle', and nothing shows approval workflows or PTO flowing automatically into payroll runs beyond a 'timecard sync' field. Missing for 10: explicit accrual-rule configuration, an approval workflow, documented automatic payroll application of PTO, and independent corroboration.
